description.value: You draw the life from every creature within a 30-foot cube centered on a point you choose within range. Each creature in the area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 10d8 necrotic damage, half as much on a success. If a hostile creature is reduced to 0 hit points by this damage, you gain temporary hit points equal to half the damage you dealt it. This power has no effect on droids or constructs.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, Level 8
